name: preview_campaign_audience
title: Count a campaign audience
description:
Count who a campaign would reach before creating it: leads by id, everyone with some tags, and/or a
pasted list, as one deduplicated set. Answers how many can be sent to, have opted out, could not be
read or are duplicates, the recipient limit, and which of the flow's list columns are missing.
A pasted list is one recipient per line: a phone (or an email for a mailbox) first,
then the columns separated by tabs or commas, the first line naming them. A number without a + is
read in the sender's country.

flow_id.description: The flow it will send, from `list_flows`.

channel_id.description: Decides whether the list is read as phones or emails.

tag_match.description: With several tags: leads with `any` (default) or `all` of them.

pasted_recipients.description: The list, laid out as above.
